Which of the following definitions creates a linear combination of the functions $f(x)$ and $g(x)$?

```{devoirs_choices}
#| label: choices_lfc.1.kdw
- '$h(x) \equiv f(x) \times g(x)$':
    correct: false
- '$h(x) \equiv f(g(x))$':
    correct: false
- '$h(x) \equiv a \cdot f(x) + b \cdot g(x)$':
    correct: true
- '$h(x) \equiv \frac{f(x)}{g(x)}$':
    correct: false
```
